source_anchors: M B14; L C7/C9; G B5
rules.meaning: Before public opening, adopt a concrete setup, installation or operational test for the stage, sound or venue equipment. A heading, equipment list or unresolved question is insufficient.
Before opening, adopt a count/check of required props or materials tied to preparation or custody. Merely listing supplies is insufficient.
Adopt a pre-event full-flow rehearsal or walk-through that checks transitions, movement or handoffs. A performance introduction or vague training label is insufficient.
Assign an owner concrete sound/equipment/playback or stage-flow control actions during operation. A title without duty is insufficient.
Assign staff a real crowd/order/safety management action for the public area. A role name or static location alone is insufficient.
Assign an owner whole-event operating coordination, cross-zone dispatch or decision authority. Local watchkeeping or weather-only duty is insufficient.
Adopt verification that a participant ticket, booking or voucher matches the actual craft session/time before admission.
Adopt a session-specific stop/control that enforces no more than forty craft participants; copying the number without an admission action is insufficient.
When a craft session is full, adopt truthful explanation plus a feasible still-available alternative or non-guaranteeing waitlist.
Assign an instructor or teacher a concrete craft technique/process demonstration or teaching action.
Assign staff concrete craft-material/tool distribution, seating or hands-on guidance; unrelated ticket distribution is insufficient.

source_anchors: M three consecutive slots; L C17; G B21/B31 R2
rules.meaning: After each craft session and before the next, adopt both work-surface cleanup and tool recovery/count/return.
Assign an owner concrete spectator/visitor flow action such as queueing, diversion, passage protection or orderly seating.
Resolve simultaneous plaza/hall duties through dedicated coverage, relief/handoff or secondary support explicitly conditional on primary-post coverage.

source_anchors: M B20; L scissors C5; G B44
rules.meaning: Adopt adult/teacher/staff supervision or close assistance while children use tools or perform the craft operation.
Adopt pre-opening first-aid supplies or assigned confirmation of usable venue response resources/access/contact path.
Assign an owner concrete meal ordering, quantity, delivery or timing coordination for event staff.
Adopt relief, rotation, handoff or staggered breaks that prevent live operating posts from being abandoned.
Assign a responsible role authority to decide a conditional weather pause, move, adjustment or termination.
Adopt communication of a weather decision to affected operating posts, staff or participants.
For performer/host illness, absence or nonarrival, adopt a concrete replacement, script adjustment, pause, escalation or other executable response.

source_anchors: M handcraft dependency; L C13; G B43
rules.meaning: For instructor delay/nonarrival, assign a responsible role and concrete participant holding, explanation, contact or interim activity.
Adopt an inspection or concrete control of the stage/performance surface or slip hazard before use.
Adopt checks or protective controls for both performance props and electrical/audio cables in the same stage operating context.

source_anchors: M controlled interaction; G B36, interpreted without forbidding organized interaction
rules.meaning: Adopt a real prohibition/control preventing audience, children or unauthorized people entering/crossing the protected stage/work area, while allowing organized interaction.
At closeout, adopt a material/stock/tool count or reconciliation that can reveal loss, damage or consumption difference.

source_anchors: L equipment and closeout; G B36/B50
rules.meaning: At closeout, adopt both equipment power-off and performance-prop return/storage; equipment return alone is insufficient.
Adopt a daily/end-of-day issue, exception or unfinished-item debrief/record by an accountable owner.
Adopt selection/curation of photos and a concrete handoff/submission for publicity or project use.
Bind an actual video/edit/draft deliverable to review or approval before external publication, or hand it off explicitly for review.

source_anchors: M fixed craft sessions and forty-person limit; G experience-session operating rows
rules.meaning: Adopt the complete session-admission lifecycle: validate entitlement to the exact slot, mark or redeem it against reuse, count actual occupancy against forty, and transfer the confirmed count or status to the teaching team. A reservation check, copied limit or isolated ticket action is partial and does not complete this owner.

source_anchors: L material and media duties; G daily closeout
rules.meaning: Adopt all three daily closeout handoffs: material or asset reconciliation with a recipient or reconciliation purpose; unresolved-issue carryover with an owner and next checkpoint or deadline; and selected media handoff with recipient or purpose plus review before external publication. A collection-only checklist or raw-media transfer is partial and does not complete this owner.

shared_boundaries: Read the complete candidate document, relevant table row, section context, public instruction and supplied source materials; no keyword, layout or literal title is required.
passed=true requires an adopted executable duty established by cited candidate evidence. A heading, copied noun list, rubric language, rejected/negated action or unresolved question is insufficient.
Accept supported Chinese synonyms, reordered prose, coherent related-row evidence, proposed operating methods and pending person identities where the duty itself is adopted.
Do not invent numeric, staffing, certification, medical, safety or media requirements beyond each declared meaning and supplied sources.
Return one assessment for every declared rule ID with real candidate evidence IDs. Do not score or infer model/condition identity.
